resources.string: Your phone becomes an instant camera. Frame, smile, click.
A pocket thermal printer turns every shot into a paper souvenir in a few seconds, with no ink at all.
Polaroid, photo strip or receipt: pick a template, add a caption and the date. Every print stays in your history.
FotoFlash uses the camera to take photos and Bluetooth to talk to your printer. Your photos never leave the phone.
To connect to the paired printer
